brief:
Three people, including a child, were wounded in strikes on Gaza's al-Shati neighborhood, Shehab Wire reported. The attacks struck the residential area as Israeli military operations continued across the territory.

The incidents mark the latest casualties in the densely populated district, where civilian infrastructure has faced repeated strikes. The al-Shati neighborhood, home to thousands of residents, has been a frequent target zone throughout the conflict. No additional details on the identities of the wounded or the extent of their injuries were immediately available.
